title: PageDescriptor
description: Describes a runtime UI page. Pages create menu items and choose how an entity or dashboard is rendered.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: `name` is the stable route/menu key and should be URL-safe kebab-case (for example `customers` or `event-calendar`). `title` is user-facing. For entity pages, set `entityName` to an existing entity. Configure list/gallery/card visibility with `columns`, filtering with `filters`, server-enforced scoping with `backendFilter`, related-record access with `relationships`, and create/edit UI with form names. Use `enumPresentations` to override enum display for this page only. For `dashboard` pages, provide `dashboard` and omit entity-only fields unless intentionally supported by the runtime. Do not put page-only settings on entity properties.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference used when this descriptor is stored as a model descriptor file.

name.description: Stable URL-safe page identifier. Prefer kebab-case, for example 'customers', 'event-calendar', or 'sales-dashboard'. This becomes part of the runtime route and is referenced by saveSuccessPageName and relationships.

app.description: Name of the low-code app that owns this page. Omit for the default app. Must match an apps[].name.

title.description: Display title for the menu item and page header.

icon.description: FontAwesome icon class for the menu item, for example 'fa-solid fa-users'.

showInMenu.description: Whether the page gets a menu item. Set false for pages that are only reached through relationships, saveSuccessPageName, or direct links.

entityName.description: Full name of the root entity this page displays. Required for dataGrid, kanban, calendar, gallery, and form pages. Usually omitted for dashboard pages.

groupByProperty.description: Property name to group entities by. Required for kanban pages. Must reference a property on entityName, preferably an enum/status property with a small fixed set of values.

calendarStartProperty.description: Date or DateTime property used as the start date for calendar pages. Required for calendar pages.

calendarEndProperty.description: Optional Date or DateTime property used as the end date for calendar pages. Use when events can span a date range.

calendarTimeProperty.description: Optional Time property used as the start time for calendar pages when the start date is date-only or time is stored separately.

calendarDurationProperty.description: Optional numeric property used as duration in minutes for calendar pages. Use this instead of calendarEndProperty when records store duration.

galleryImageProperty.description: Optional Image property used as the cover image for gallery pages. The property should have entity property type image; an image collection property is supported with galleryImagePresentation.

galleryImagePresentation.description: How gallery cards render galleryImageProperty. 'coverLightbox' shows a cover image that opens a lightbox; 'inlineSlider' shows an inline slider (useful for image collections). Omit for the default cover presentation.

defaultSortProperty.description: Optional property used as the default sorting field when the client does not send explicit sorting. Must reference a property on entityName.

defaultSortDescending.description: Whether the default sort property is sorted descending.

defaultFileExportMode.description: Default spreadsheet output for file/image columns. 0 exports file names, 1 exports metadata columns, 2 exports temporary download-link columns, and 3 exports file names with download links.

allowFileBundleExport.description: Whether ZIP file bundle export is available for exportable file/image columns on this page.

importEnabled.description: Whether the React runtime exposes guided Excel/CSV import for this page.

columns.description: Page-owned column/card field configuration. Use for dataGrid, kanban card fields, calendar event fields, and gallery card fields. Each propertyName must reference a property on entityName or a dot-separated related path such as 'CustomerId.Name'.

filters.description: Page-owned filter configuration for filterable page types. Each propertyName must reference a property on entityName or a related path. Use this instead of legacy property-level UI filter settings.

enumPresentations.description: Page-level overrides for enum value display (label, presentation, color, icon). Each propertyName may appear once.

relationships.description: Reverse relationships shown from this page: records of other entities whose foreign key points at the page entity. Each id must be unique within the page.

backendFilter.description: Server-enforced filter expression that is always applied to this page's queries and cannot be removed by the client.

order.description: Menu sort order (lower values appear first)

formName.description: Name of the form to render. Required when type is 'form'. Must match a form descriptor whose entityName matches this page entityName.

createFormName.description: Name of the form to use when creating records from dataGrid, kanban, calendar, or gallery pages. Must match a form descriptor for the same entity.

editFormName.description: Name of the form to use when editing records from dataGrid, kanban, calendar, or gallery pages. Must match a form descriptor for the same entity.

createFormDisplay.description: How to display the create form. Use 'modal' for quick CRUD; use 'page' for longer forms or when deep links are desired.

editFormDisplay.description: How to display the edit form. Use 'modal' for quick CRUD; use 'page' for longer forms or when deep links are desired.

saveSuccessNavigation.description: Navigation behavior after a standalone form page saves successfully. 'stay' keeps the user on the form page; 'page' navigates to saveSuccessPageName; 'url' navigates to saveSuccessUrl.

saveSuccessPageName.description: Existing page name to open after a form page saves successfully when saveSuccessNavigation is 'page'.

saveSuccessUrl.description: URL or application path to open after a form page saves successfully when saveSuccessNavigation is 'url'.

dashboard.description: Dashboard layout and visualizations. Required only when type is dashboard.

group.description: Name of the page group this page belongs to. Must match pageGroups[].name. Omit for root-level pages.

permissionConfig.description: Optional page operation permission overrides. Omit operations to use generated defaults.

interceptors.description: Page-scoped Create/Update/Delete command interceptors that run for commands issued through this page, ordered relative to entity interceptors by entityExecutionOrder.

extendsLowerLayer.description: When true, this descriptor overrides selected fields of a page with the same name defined in a lower model layer; title, entityName, and type-specific required fields become optional.
